'''Holland:''' {{legend0|#6674de|60–70%}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Mark Parkinson]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Sam Brownback]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsKS}} The '''2010 Kansas gubernatorial election''' was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the [[governor of Kansas]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] U.S. senator [[Sam Brownback]] defeated [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] state senator [[Tom Holland (politician)|Tom Holland]].
